briefdescription.para: Bring up the device by powering it on, enabling its clocks and releasing its reset (except for core devices, whose reset is handled as part of request wakeup).

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the device to bring up.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful, error code otherwise.

inbodydescription.para: Perform actions to bring up the device
Skip releasing reset if device is core type; since it is done as the part of request wakeup
Release reset for peripheral and TCM devices

briefdescription.para: Power down the domain associated with a device.

detaileddescription.para: Records the power use count expected after shutdown, requests the power-down event, and clears the idle-complete flag only when that request succeeds. Devices without a power domain require no action and return success.

parameterdescription.para: Device whose power domain is to be shut down.
Pointer to the caller's debug error code.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS when no power domain exists or power-down succeeds; otherwise, the status returned by the power-domain event handler.

briefdescription.para: Shut down a device as part of a generic-device FSM transition.

detaileddescription.para: Powers down core devices through their core handler. Memory and IPI devices remain powered and return success. For other devices, asserts peripheral reset where applicable, releases their clocks, and requests power-domain shutdown while recording the expected power use count.

parameterdescription.para: Device being transitioned to the unused state. Must be non-NULL.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS when shutdown completes or is intentionally skipped; otherwise, the error returned by core power-down, reset, clock, or power-domain handling. Also reports the corresponding debug error.

briefdescription.para: Initialize the device FSM for runtime device operations.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the runtime device operations structure.
